verdict.rationale: Airbyte natively supports scheduled/cron-based syncs, incremental replication, and event notifications, letting pipelines run unattended in the background, and this can be extended via API/Terraform/Airflow for full automation-as-code control. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that autonomous scheduled syncs run reliably at scale (community evidence only covers setup/support friction, not scheduling failures).
